independent_checks.endpoint_isomorphism: The values q(2p),q(3p),q(4p) are an invertible evaluation set on the three Fourier modes 1,i,-i. Hence Phi is an isomorphism and conjugates N to the three-mode phase shift.
independent_checks.feedback_polynomial: From char(N)=(x-1)(x^2+1), N^3=N^2-N+I. The matrix determinant lemma and the zero first column of M give h3=1, h2=1+h1-h0, tr(B)=1-h0, and det(B)=1+h1-h0.
independent_checks.two_square_determinant: For the lower 2x2 block, det(I+B^2)=(1-det(B))^2+tr(B)^2, yielding (h0-h1)^2+(1-h0)^2. The p mod 4 split and rank classification then follow exactly.
independent_checks.singular_consistency: Every left null vector of I+M^2 decomposes into the plus/minus-i eigenspaces. Pairing with the observable matching N-eigenvector forces ell*b=0, so every left null kills 4Mb-2b.
independent_checks.bottom_reciprocity: Backward unit-pivot uniqueness identifies the generalized endpoint state of v with the normalized common line; four-periodicity then gives a*N^3*v=Delta_minus with the audited sign.
independent_checks.residual_redundancy: Writing e0,e1,e3 for the 2p,3p,bottom residuals, the characteristic relation makes O(I+N^2)x=(e1+e3)(1,1,1). Direct two-step source propagation gives R=(h0*b-N*b)e0+(c-b)e1+c*e3, without determinant division.
independent_checks.formal_equivalence: Because the six-row system contains the three terminal rows and their two independent minors are unit multiples of Theta and Psi, formal solvability is exactly Delta_plus!=0, Theta=Psi=0.
